description: This file implements GTP-U gateway classes and functions for handling NG-U TNL PDU sessions over UDP connections, including both active UDP-based and stub (no core) versions.

classes.name: udp_ngu_tnl_session
classes.description: Implements a NG-U TNL PDU session over UDP, handling PDU forwarding and data notification.

classes.name: udp_ngu_gateway
classes.description: Implements a NG-U gateway for UDP connections, creating UDP TNL PDU sessions.

classes.name: no_core_ngu_tnl_pdu_session
classes.description: Stub implementation of NG-U TNL PDU session that performs no actions.

classes.name: no_core_ngu_gateway
classes.description: Stub NG-U gateway that creates no-op TNL PDU sessions.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new udp_ngu_tnl_session with configuration and network setup.

methods.name: handle_pdu
methods.description: Forwards PDU to UDP interface or does nothing in stub version.

methods.name: on_new_pdu
methods.description: Handles new incoming PDU, forwarding to data notifier or doing nothing in stub.

methods.name: get_bind_address
methods.description: Retrieves bind IP address from UDP gateway.

methods.name: get_bind_port
methods.description: Retrieves bind port from UDP gateway.

methods.name: create_udp_gtpu_gateway
methods.description: Factory function to create UDP-based NG-U gateway.

methods.name: create_no_core_gtpu_gateway
methods.description: Factory function to create stub NG-U gateway.
